mapper.select: SELECT 'arb' AS kind, id, name, connection_id AS conn, target_db AS db, target_table AS tbl, config_json AS payload FROM arb_workflows UNION ALL SELECT 'wide' , id, name, 0, target_db, target_table, config_json FROM wide_table_tasks UNION ALL SELECT 'query' , id, name, 0, '' , '' , config_json FROM query_workflows UNION ALL SELECT 'dag' , id, name, 0, '' , '' , nodes_json FROM wf_tasks UNION ALL SELECT 'visual' , id, name, 0, database, '' , visual_config FROM sql_queries WHERE visual_config != ''
SELECT id, name, database AS db, sql_text AS sql FROM sql_queries WHERE sql_text != ''

SELECT t.id, t.name, t.connection_id AS conn, t.target_db AS db, t.target_table AS tbl, t.source_object, d.id AS source_id, d.type AS source_type, d.config_enc FROM sync_tasks t LEFT JOIN data_sources d ON d.id=t.data_source_id WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM sync_runs r WHERE r.task_id=t.id AND r.status='running') OR IS_USED_LOCK(CONCAT('el_sync_task_',t.id)) IS NOT NULL

SELECT 'arb' AS kind, w.id, w.name, w.connection_id AS conn, w.target_db AS db, w.target_table AS tbl, w.config_json AS payload FROM arb_workflows w WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM arb_workflow_runs r WHERE r.workflow_id=w.id AND r.status='running') OR IS_USED_LOCK(CONCAT('el_arb_workflow_',w.id)) IS NOT NULL UNION ALL SELECT 'dag', w.id, w.name, 0, '', '', w.nodes_json FROM wf_tasks w WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM wf_runs r WHERE r.workflow_id=w.id AND r.status='running') UNION ALL SELECT 'query', w.id, w.name, 0, '', '', w.config_json FROM query_workflows w WHERE EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM query_workflow_runs r WHERE r.workflow_id=w.id AND r.status='running')
SELECT id, type, config_enc FROM data_sources WHERE id=#{id}
